title: Retrieve standard data from Seatrack
text: Users NINA Polarinstitute (using computer within networks’ IP-addresses) can connect Seatrack database. PostgreSQL (9.6) database answering address seatrack.nina., standard port 5432. Users use individual login user names passwords. Contact Jens Åström (jens.astrom@nina.) details usernames passwords. instruction deals preferred way connecting database, using R seatrackR package. Another option connect dedicated database management software, Pgadmin3 (4), HeidiSQL, similar. users may prefer use MS Access interface. simplify connection, use convenience function connectSeatrack. creates connection named con using packages DBI RPostgres.
